_comment: Non-secret structure only. Secrets (bot token, chat id, ntfy topic) go in .env — see .env.example. Env vars override these fields at load time.
_voice: Voice notes → text via whisper.cpp, TWO models for true bilingual: he→ivrit-ai (Hebrew-elite), en/auto→vanilla large-v3-turbo (clean English, no Hebrew transliteration). transcribeLanguage is the DEFAULT mode; change it live from Telegram with /lang he|en|auto. whisperBin/whisperModelHe/whisperModelMulti/ffmpegBin have sensible defaults.
